newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BDP brings forward futures trade hours.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BDP brings forward futures trade hours.

text.p: Oporto Derivatives Exchange (BDP) will bring forward its trading hours for futures contracts on Portuguese bonds and the three-month Lisbor effective from February 3, an official source of BDP said.
Trade will take place between 0830 and 1630 local time. Presently trade is between 0900 and 1645 local time.
Trading hours for futures contracts on the PSI-20 index of 20 leading Portuguese shares will remain unchanged.
The source gave no reason for the change in trading hours of the bond and Lisbor contracts and did not say how long the new hours would remain in force.
